item.text:
{
  "concerns": [
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.0f30f5c64e531a581eb403e4","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.86f9bbe329a69a43a5bf3ba17505cb63248df55f53b691cdfc9954b41200627b"]}],"rationale":"The introduction identifies authentication and monitoring expectations, not gifts or a uniquely identified second duty. The synthetic dependency and edition uncertainty remain unresolved.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.1ec37b9436d73f758771a614","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.1c41716a032d20c3d1716ab3db9dbddc629ff42612167b1823677834230df7b5"]}],"rationale":"This background heading supplies no rule resolving either original question or the synthetic dependency.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.dbcb7b0365b22a677ef7a535","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.60cd16e9d70cc107df29185b577e6c1c0a26d0f0b004988b9d50362d4a44e9c7"]}],"rationale":"The phishing background does not identify the second duty or establish its performance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.14725332f4579b3499499691","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.1c98648c7d5d849bb0052039a4819a6531a2283f9ca47b5b19705c3d37942d2a"]}],"rationale":"The account of suspected attacks explains risk; it does not supply a gift prohibition or a duty-performance determination.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.4d649e548aefa46fc58413a4","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.360b925998ba35ead392a43ca89c53f1d6a9e1d4c56a97eaf5e48173c07914ed"]}],"rationale":"The conduct heading must be read with its substantive provisions and cannot resolve the unidentified duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.3ebfea91adf43d0402437729","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.60cc5a0e8ffbc1ecd63c13db5c2cdc2291cfecf0e6dfc6d6f726209ee6f30e50"]}],"rationale":"The broad protection expectation introduces multiple measures; an opaque overall-compliance fact would conceal their separate requirements.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.e58db3d999bc776358947b7b","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.ff05feba8e46b240409c57735594281af07fcfb9dc6439fb9bfff8964e4dbc7a"]}],"rationale":"Prevention covers both login and device binding. Neither performance criteria nor the original question mapping are resolved.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.03797db93f93d94a79778157","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.ded2296cffeabb76684fa519120be74feda72b3e203f6d2796fa9cf72c823be1"]}],"rationale":"Detection, surveillance and timely notification remain separate expectations. Their position as section B does not establish that they are the intended second duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.4927b100420f6bae329f9206","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.f6727c495230b58a0b46056f048d955622b889c0f3f6865344b08ec722678086"]}],"rationale":"Incident containment, asset protection, client notification and SFC reporting must remain visible; authentication alone does not establish their performance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.0cdeb66abe37dd6daffe6083","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.0fa3c49a44747bf2b34770f5813108011a6b30283c0b2b265d9cda7147fc1f13"]}],"rationale":"Client awareness, alerts and guidance are distinct from authentication and remain unassessed.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.ebe60ce31598437b774cb911","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.b3ec48d2698ba90a3af056d24bfa6c5a12910416d508d747c629088a61f28b06"]}],"rationale":"This prevention heading does not independently identify or discharge the second duty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.6b7eef21815315b958da1f9d","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.ff482545063b548441d81e7c0f7680a48a642b7f0a5d71a271284e2ff2e6e0c1"]}],"rationale":"Robust authentication must be read with both following processes, the existing-device exception and the implementation provisions.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.561857b0a1947720994f1902","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.c402d37d255a40b526ded588ffd420f807735f75da7f935ec64f70a5a1a0afd2"]}],"rationale":"Login is one covered process; assessing it alone would omit device registration and binding and other duties.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.fd7d2de0842323d099a38762","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.ac54668ba977eaec6909bd64fbc4d334d68e7a2ef0fe2201623d58f044fc0526"]}],"rationale":"Preserve the express exception: existing clients need not rebind already-bound devices. It does not exempt subsequent registration, login controls or other duties.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.9a2c3211c24fdce283bdc008","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.ceea2b7591ed3edf84becce5897eb19a64049ad337b39210dc63999fb3d9c26d"]}],"rationale":"Authentication choice depends on the firm's circumstances, platform types and risk profiles; adequacy requires an assessment not supplied here.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.5ed8bcd483c4e0a1fa7cdc22","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.177f8d1aa37bc1c8ba615217e332392c69821e52f2949c4bedf1fc16567ed891"]}],"rationale":"The OTP restriction must be reconciled with transitional OTP use and safeguards, the appendix and referenced circulars. It cannot become an unconditional gift prohibition.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.151bbd0f2c394c26f3af5ad9","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.3d08a67e61f96579a9a92c82e8b2ef557179ddc60dff59ae9583df11774eb2a8"]}],"rationale":"The appendix supplies examples of robust solutions; the wording does not establish an exhaustive list or resolve acceptance of every alternative.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.104e750a1851f3cf1663b248","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.c48b7b29158c2fad2aa7a6e3705a88f1d0352e2c41b92ad895ddce9c6d8cb59c"]}],"rationale":"Passkey characteristics do not alone establish compliant implementation; appendix certification, setup, recovery and synchronisation controls remain relevant.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.0e7bae377aedd60b4349c79f","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.b9269d0f49c141d30ddf3cdcd3e04921be1e21a41de0723c074d2691dec4eeb1"]}],"rationale":"Bound-device authentication depends on robust verification and applies to mobile and desktop applications. The appendix's verification alternatives and conditions remain material.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.0.b9216d0cc9f8d4404a30571c","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.964fff3b6cc9bd1a1fd6d98b75613480cd4182ee8c4d2eb73748e3bf469ebda7"]}],"rationale":"Supporting the possession factor does not by itself prove satisfaction of two-factor authentication or the other expectations.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.0b0bef7c9756f359168f82c0","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.9d93b41ece4b15b45373a65655b30bd16f33ca67521ed9cb8718015a897026bc"]}],"rationale":"The described passkey login and typical unlocking methods do not establish actual implementation or duty performance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.7b3eac73c68f514a9d6bf033","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.b39a8041d839c0604cf5f011623bade2062f475a74b9144908c7931333f6b2ba"]}],"rationale":"Device binding requires an additional authentication factor; merely having a bound device cannot stand for satisfaction of the full login requirement.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.d43364cb54a8cd5cad510adb","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.342dc480131379b97dfeb7cb296405d147bf514089713536661fd2020dcd6382"]}],"rationale":"Preserve the general three-passkey and/or three-device limits and the adequate-assessment route for larger requests. Neither an absolute cap nor an invented combined cap is justified.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.e07c11ba3ed4b1495787980b","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.443234bbae4d9068d17745353b28c9a665d9d36a0ded4f380c21e89299c7903f"]}],"rationale":"Preserve non-disableable timeouts, assessments and monitoring, and the longer-timeout exception tied to trading needs and close monitoring. Thirty minutes is an example, not an unconditional maximum.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.a17f1724ff90272ce14cbad5","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.efaa1095a04aaa8a98e4b86b6465b5911df9688a3dfb484a9daef94ef2d83114"]}],"rationale":"Ongoing technological review and proportionate control assessment cannot be discharged by a one-time authentication test.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.e1e7c529999827cd4e36b6a3","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.af914c3d315e5942875e59b03130414dc463d439ef1a80127a9667424b983c24"]}],"rationale":"The detection heading introduces separate measures but does not resolve the original second-duty identity.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.0454a928378e32b6bb303a70","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.2bac64471104517d93d8d83bf91bc68d8a2317a35f3e48cd7944e7de99459890"]}],"rationale":"Prompt notifications cover successful logins and high-risk activities, with multiple channels where applicable. SMS notification must not be confused with SMS authentication.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.11c5864c6ae573f4de26479a","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.02c27fbb094d0b47ddcd4b1c2f448e138314dfd392aae91af422a4920a8d6b62"]}],"rationale":"The firm should remind clients to report suspicious activity immediately; this reminder expectation and its applicable response context remain unassessed.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.f2c32d9483ec4f313f2beba8","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.31529aed329dabe25f0393ac8b39aa53c189e395a747aba58da9c2d9b2db3acb"]}],"rationale":"Preserve the distinction between strong encouragement to obtain confirmation and the illustrative verification option; neither is automatically an absolute transaction prohibition.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.0f79c62adea580773804cc85","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.124ef6d71ff3579410e5f8bc4792ff8bfd1e03f1fd0c5b4cbaaabbf6c5deebac"]}],"rationale":"Monitoring, prompt follow-up, direct verification and suspension where appropriate remain distinct from authentication and require factual and professional assessment.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.668e43db231056cf179f5ea6","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.6111bd47b710077bda5137a5262cca1af0094df738fe596813c586b70a890713"]}],"rationale":"Predefined thresholds and red-flag analysis are required components of transaction monitoring, but no universal numerical thresholds are supplied.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.39d1fb5e3909dce9733e129f","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.53efc2c14c4389bd6b97b20e59d63d6032223cc4458e6f69bf1cd26572bbc9d3"]}],"rationale":"Threshold setting depends on client profile, history, account activity, device use and login patterns as appropriate; fixed invented cutoffs would lose this context.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.55063bac309f17a36d8e5b04","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.03e6c9e69d39b0383138844090e931e87187208c01c0dab0c194eb44a3055b35"]}],"rationale":"The introductory wording identifies potential red flags, not conclusive violations or an exhaustive test of performance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.abbfff556ca938871ffcdfcc","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.b90199fd029642dc4cc7dd629e57f9ace30b789f7e5fa88adbd613a125da456c"]}],"rationale":"Unusual patterns, hours and losses are contextual red flags; their significance and time horizons are not quantified.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.9b555b3807fd30d3d61c0bb3","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.011c0b0fd0ce9a819aff76d93570b6bf032d0d5a1c8e56741feee8710eccd812"]}],"rationale":"Unusually numerous illiquid or small-cap transactions are a potential red flag, not an automatic prohibition or complete monitoring test.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.e4b96bc08cb5ed8a0ffa5164","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.490917c30697a25e079ae3503844c563cf2ba207de5f279eb24d3e065aa5e999"]}],"rationale":"Unusual transactions following account changes or device binding require contextual scrutiny; the source supplies no fixed meaning for shortly after.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.266b266d9d910592106f242f","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.ef256649bf705976928f5e2f9b07fadf99e44d1c13d65cfacd84a658cdd1f55f"]}],"rationale":"Sufficient device and login logs and timely review remain separate expectations. The listed irregularities are examples, not a complete executable criterion.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.01ded91cbd8e83d50745186b","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.df32dbba277680b536d3e18b71372e05ed01e6775c7f47fbdeb206bcab1bc881"]}],"rationale":"The response and reporting heading cannot independently establish the intended second duty or its performance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.52d20c483c622de96cbb0619","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.96a4f5b2ed84ca329574ff5079b4d875ebf73abe59fb8a711f0d83c7271a525d"]}],"rationale":"Procedures must address prompt response and immediate containment, asset protection, notification and prevention of further compromise; none is established by an authentication result.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.1.18c1c12871e97da4aa8e5b01","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.ed3f5cc62649895dc3ca6b9be9b2615408d1b5b0e067182c62a78a2b95f497b5"]}],"rationale":"Immediate reporting, root-cause analysis, detailed incident records and remediation remain separate expectations, including the referenced reporting dependencies.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.e3b330ce9fb1b10d24e03d51","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.425eb6a5785f2e65f4befc0a4720683c8706e6f9c9bcb883a6b496d2f0237864"]}],"rationale":"The awareness heading supplies context for separate client-protection measures and does not resolve either original question.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.fd3d22675e42f34e2be482c3","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.e3477be4544e2b5e4ca297009a6e1c77cd63e0d6dcc1216875c11a00cf2a8ca5"]}],"rationale":"Reasonable steps to alert and remind clients require contextual assessment and must include the following specified subjects.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.8ae9a0a4d978729a147c3eda","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.2bca19643bb317bea1f27dec241d11a22d206a7a68464135b6317628730c89f3"]}],"rationale":"Warnings about impersonation, fake services and social engineering remain substantive awareness measures, not evidence of completed performance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.0072e4c7b8defec5b21c5119","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.1d7605f6cf894d7b7fb3ed48b726bba669fda687148c5467d50692acd8e2ce24"]}],"rationale":"The firm should remind clients about credential compromise, nondisclosure and vigilance; these communications cannot be inferred from technical controls.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.d25df565b1f9847dffaad89b","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.b279dd5cf45b2fa70b73afaf2f7008db1c4a8f289800dcadfdf1a14325973ece"]}],"rationale":"Regular reminders about passwords, trading limits, alerts and transaction review remain separate; the source gives no fixed reminder interval.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.1a463ab700e7b0783ee9d98c","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.7dea8aa86cebe2e1cd1fbd2866ac736af4639b97b593b8c25807d295980e6953"]}],"rationale":"The timeline heading must be read with differentiated deadlines and transitional safeguards; it establishes no standalone date test.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.ef0c0d2039863a22e63f67ce","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.d53986141af4432eb397307330a843f7009d14ac40cdb8803677551a84b19832"]}],"rationale":"The introductory expectation applies to the following timeline provisions and cannot determine performance by itself.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.c20c54f901371219c0d1bba7","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.2b0625ce543b24fd7665c648fa22b67d70d3bdf26ad5a61c3a0570cc54525d19"]}],"rationale":"Sections B and C require immediate review and necessary enhancements. Pragmatic compliance assessment for system updates supplies no fixed extension or blanket exemption.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.00a512e70bc1ba91f633ca12","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.b999462464b6bfeac9aed843263bd17cf9a9bc421210c437e726f844a2fe9496"]}],"rationale":"Awareness enhancements are expected as soon as practicable; the authentication long-stop date cannot replace this timing standard.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.e9ef60359e00024f838cc945","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.abc000474efe9c96d9c199c2bc8b5fb455e106070c7c8b9d49c09181a8ef461b"]}],"rationale":"Preserve implementation as soon as practicable, the 8 July 2027 long-stop, and immediate implementation for large internet brokers. Large-broker classification and edition applicability remain unresolved; a date comparison alone would omit these conditions.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.9f11383a73e943a32754b44c","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.c6ff1a974de95630b2554e1d145ac1168aea25b5ebad94df4a1cebeba5e61e57"]}],"rationale":"The implementation-period introduction governs the following testing, rollout and communication measures; it is not a general suspension of duties.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.9c5bce0d1cd7cea1cf5bb355","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.cdb8b29168c6411d1ce3e639afcf2721d27c3ac90ff3e8b0af9b04563ed8f20b"]}],"rationale":"System enhancement includes adequate testing before deployment. Test adequacy and actual sequencing are not established by the source.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.8c815d163d4df9e479936053","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.83816419aca30ca72270b17cc94a9336c5f983b38c44c6f4745ea535de678d34"]}],"rationale":"Rollout must reach all clients as soon as practicable, subject to preserving the existing-device exception; a single-client test would be incomplete.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.338ef1d7a5fa40e97d6e3786","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.e14d2044d25d77fecf6ce3407b58b0532a790913706f368abf22c11dba44607d"]}],"rationale":"Communication, guidance and support are implementation expectations distinct from deploying authentication software.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.784cba47166515d86d748662","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.41a9ab4ce36b89d00ec587247ca0620ee6f8b5006926e8e034c8540b77036e91"]}],"rationale":"Transitional OTP risk requires enhanced detection, and identification of suspicious or potentially fraudulent activity triggers immediate suspension or restriction of access. Preserve the express must and do not treat transition as unconditional permission.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.d40dc9504b76321b6636e6f5","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.4cc07af7e8dab7738ed6f33bfe1440e2befe025cc11ae657af8a474ee3ae9640"]}],"rationale":"Anticipated difficulty meeting the implementation period calls for immediate case-officer notification; notification does not itself extend the deadline.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.17b1ccbb29dad8116889068c","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.9d9ebaea6843f53592b2de0991dd83efbb75c802591294d41c1fa3c3a74b1d75"]}],"rationale":"The management heading introduces responsibility provisions and does not independently resolve duty performance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.a38c25a2bbfe1bab1167a40e","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.3e04038f086e1cd41a30c6de9a0ea4969d7dd4ed675b345f54f0dd7118d53e10"]}],"rationale":"Senior-management oversight, the specified Managers-in-Charge and expert assistance as necessary remain relevant; the original Distributor actor is unsupported as a general substitute.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.c625a4cc1dabdb7f15e93cd1","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.cc5be8a49644c1fe546886cae7bb767de8052b75aa5ff5ce39b79db26a86b932"]}],"rationale":"Adequate internal controls, operational capability and stated accountability for client losses depend on more than authentication. Referenced Code and VATP provisions remain dependencies.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.2.e77253f3248542a142b57cdb","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.1db961e816fa98b8c19a6e91369f18a46e1701ab97e31f20f924c1e2d4639562"]}],"rationale":"The enquiry contact supplies no substantive exception, performance criterion or resolution of edition uncertainty.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.7991cde4ad111b08d6544792","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.70375626f4dfdc8680bf8faa43d46a763ca4d32b06c550a97ae459da3c01f743"]}],"rationale":"The issuing-division label does not resolve the synthetic dependency or substantiate either original question.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.306def45da7c3d170051bd59","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.7b9074e665de0d4589d53a292b23a733adcb8a33ba13bbabb3a9c26381be5c35"]}],"rationale":"The institution label identifies the stated issuer but does not independently verify the applicable edition or duty performance.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.70dd353f1a9935b28d82861d","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.4f3c89a12776ecd157b5ad80a8475eb04560928ee3f477c43294f2b13ca5d3c6"]}],"rationale":"The enclosure marker preserves the connection to the supplied appendix; it does not discharge substantive dependencies or duties.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.93f575de507d0a290c02b66f","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.f48f768ab28871bc6566f6ee1c861afee1a751767313c7f4c937f1a35d1bd031"]}],"rationale":"The end marker does not remove the following footnotes or appendix qualifications from consideration.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.7fe64f6afd9574f41522defd","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.8baa0d7e91b32f243da6315ab0be240d2bb703c229720dcd5433366106a3af3f"]}],"rationale":"The document reference alone does not establish edition applicability or resolve the original questions.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"},
    {"concern_id":"piece.3.c8b1da84754ad659199369cd","evidence":[{"span_ids":["span.4cf57cd4f105228c357f88317f6f3ef5f972dc86434aa249b61fa95f0624517f"]},{"span_ids":["span.1ff95aa0ff2daad3babc1ab948baf7e9cb435280134d3f94c85d64be7f87a596"]}],"rationale":"This footnote marker depends on the following internet-broker definition across the batch boundary. Preserve its regulated-activity and fund-distribution qualifications without revising the other batch.","status":"RETAINED_UNRESOLVED"}
  ],
  "coverage_hash":"9e5e2387f4b5ca3f60017b035766228a9d4110d8b4a9d4cfa0e4f28d3d0e5a85",
  "interpretation_hash":"b89e00af1c5a04bde857299b9f8cefa4a43fb5727b367fccd0bee8c8efe04cd9",
  "packet_hash":"5894cfa10af7d57ee82fb3dc180ec265ed4036b10337795874bf5577f51ff49b",
  "questions":[
    {"question_hash":"6ec1d11d48960e45dc0b385876315feab76d59767cf0ae0599eb0bce71433c01","question_id":"gift.question","rationale":"Retained unresolved. The supplied circular and appendix concern internet-trading cybersecurity and provide no gift-prohibition rule.
